core_meaning.primary_meaning: Harith is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Tiller of the soil, cultivator, farmer”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Harith corresponds to the Arabic form حارث (Arabic root ح ر ث (ḥ-r-th); حَارِث (Ḥārith)). Its core sense is cultivator, tiller of the soil, farmer. Harith is Arabic حَارِث (Ḥārith) 'tiller of the soil, cultivator, farmer', from the root ح ر ث (ḥ-r-th). It is a well-documented pre-Islamic and early Islamic Arabic personal name. The source gloss 'Blooming, flourishing' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as haris (batch 27).
